Overview

Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University (KMCLU), Lucknow (U.P.), is
a State Public multidisciplinary and multilingual university with a
distinctive academic focus on languages, humanities, social sciences,
professional education, and emerging technologies. The University
integrates linguistic scholarship with interdisciplinary and skill-based
learning, aligning its mission with India’s National Education Policy
(NEP) 2020 and global higher-education benchmarks.

The University promotes multilingualism while fostering research,
employability, innovation, and social responsibility. In 2025, KMCLU
received its first NAAC accreditation with a CGPA of 2.86, demonstrating
compliance with national quality benchmarks in academic governance,
infrastructure, and institutional planning.

KMCLU was established under the Uttar Pradesh Universities Act, 2009,
and was named as Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University in 2020 to
reflect its expanded linguistic and academic mandate. Recognized
under Sections 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC, the University adheres to
nationally approved academic and governance standards.

Located in Uttar Pradesh – the heartland of India -the University aims
to provide quality education and deep understanding of India's cultural
fabric, inspiring students to build a knowledge-based society. The first
academic session of the University began in August 2013 with U.G, P.G
and Diploma programmes in various fields. Currently, the student
strength of the University exceeds 4,000 with more than 70 programmes
being offered in the current academic year.

The University offers a rich learning environment for students belonging
to different parts of the country. Since 2019, the University has
enriched its curriculum by introducing AICTE approved B. Tech.
programmes in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer
Science and Computer Science and Engineering with a specialization in
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Further expanding its
academic horizons, the University launched its L.L.M. programme under
the Faculty of Legal Studies in the Academic Session, 2021-22, along
with an M. Tech. programme under the Faculty of Engineering and
Technology. Additionally, from the Academic Session 2022-23 the
University introduced LLB and BA.LLB programmes and established the
Faculty of Pharmacy with B.Pharm and D.Pharm programmes.

KMCLU’s academic programmes prepare graduates for employment
in education, media, translation, journalism, public administration,
cultural industries, international relations, and emerging technology
sectors. The University has strengthened employability outcomes through
skill-development initiatives, and interdisciplinary exposure in
accordance with NEP 2020.

KMCLU is actively strengthening its research culture through
interdisciplinary initiatives and infrastructure development. The
establishment of IoT and Artificial Intelligence Networking
Laboratories supports applied research and training in Machine Learning,
and Data Science, bridging humanities, language studies, and technology.
